title: tracevals section of manni.config.yaml
description: Settings for manni tracevals, held under the `tracevals` key of the config file shared by the manni family of tools. Sibling keys belong to other tools and are not validated here.

provider.description: Which provider judges: auto, anthropic, openai, claude-cli, or llama-cpp. Overrides the family's top-level `providers.provider` for tracevals only. Connection settings — an endpoint, an API key's environment variable, the Claude CLI command — live in that top-level `providers:` map, never here.

model.description: The model within `provider`, which must be named at this level. Unset, the inference library's default for the winning provider is used; manni pins no model id of its own.

maxTurns.description: Stop after this many ensemble runs. A cached ensemble spends none. Unset means unbounded; the remaining evals report `skipped` with the reason `turn budget` rather than aborting the run.

redact.description: Extra regular expressions scrubbed from the session digest before it is sent to a judge provider. Applied on top of the built-in secret shapes, never instead of them; each source is compiled with the `g` flag, and a match is replaced with `[redacted]`. Pattern matching is best-effort — --deterministic-only is the only setting that guarantees nothing leaves the machine.

graders.description: Per-grader settings. Only graders with a knob of their own appear here; every other grader is configured entirely by the eval that names it.

enabled.description: Run `command`-graded evals. On by default (ADR 01011). Set false — or pass --no-commands — to evaluate a trace without executing anything that trace's project declares; those evals then report `skipped` with a reason, never `pass`.

capture.description: Session manifests — sha256 of every instruction artifact plus the git SHA, recorded at session start by `manni tracevals capture` and read back by `run` to make staleness exact instead of an mtime guess. See ADR 01024.

dir.description: Directory manifests are written to and looked for, resolved against the project root. `run` also accepts one placed beside the trace as `<trace>.manifest.json`, and --manifest names one outright.

maxTurns.description: Stop after this many inference calls, one per artifact filled. A cached artifact spends none. Unset means unbounded.

calibrate.description: Settings for `manni tracevals calibrate` — measuring the tool's verdicts against a human's answers. See ADR 01022.

labels.description: Default labels sidecar, resolved against this config file's directory. Overridden by --labels.

maxFalsePass.description: Fail the calibration run (exit 1) above this many false passes — labelled fail, judged pass. Unset by default: a calibration run is a measurement, not a gate.

maxFalseFail.description: Fail the calibration run above this many false fails — labelled pass, judged fail.

maxReview.description: Fail the calibration run above this many needs-review outcomes across the whole corpus.

sweep.description: Values --sweep tries on each axis, one axis at a time with the others held at their configured value. The corpus is judged once at the largest ensembleRuns here and every cell is re-scored from those cached runs, so the grid costs nothing beyond that one run.

plugins.description: Modules imported before evals are planned, so one calling registerGrader() can add a grader kind the built-ins do not cover. A relative or absolute path resolves against this file's directory, not the working directory; a bare package name resolves the way an import from this file's directory would. Load order is significant: a later entry wins a colliding kind.

reportUnusedArtifacts.description: List every skill and agent the session was offered and never used, rather than only counting them. Off by default: a real roster runs to hundreds of skills.
